description: Überschwemmungsgebiete Chemnitz (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. The listing shows 2022-06-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
